summary: Master subscription business models and customer retention with cohort analysis, CLV, and dunning workflows. Build tools you can use immediately.
lede: Subscription business models create recurring offers, while retention work measures subscriber behavior and addresses churn. This course is for renewal, customer success, lifecycle marketing, and revenue operations professionals who need practical ways to assess retention risk and report performance. Learners practice cohort analysis, customer health scorecards, renewal journeys, and dunning workflows, and explore net revenue retention, customer lifetime value to acquisition cost calculations, and AI-assisted churn scoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in recurring revenue environments and need to strengthen subscription business models and customer retention performance with practical tools. It suits the people who manage renewal risk, usage data, pricing logic, and retention reporting every day.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Excel or Google Sheets, and a working understanding of subscription metrics and renewal workflows. Familiarity with CRM reporting, customer success operations, or revenue operations will help you complete the exercises faster, but no programming experience is required.
